name: Torch
operation_language: Authoring intent only; not registered engine syntax.

rules.text: Burns 1 hour with Bright Light 20 feet and Dim Light an additional 20 feet. With the Attack action it is a Simple Melee weapon that deals 1 Fire damage on a hit.

definition.name: Torch
definition.description: A Torch burns for 1 hour, casting Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet.
